mapper.select: SELECT P2.PROJECT_ID AS projectId, P2.PROJECT_NAME AS parentProjectName, P2.END_DATE AS endDate, P2.PM_USER_ID AS pmUserId, P2.PL_USER_ID AS plUserId, ROUND(AVG(NVL(T.PROGRESS_RATE, 0)), 0) AS progressRate FROM PROJECTS P2 LEFT JOIN PROJECTS P ON P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = P2.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN TASKS T ON P.PROJECT_ID = T.PROJECT_ID WHERE P2.PARENT_PROJECT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY P2.PROJECT_ID, P2.PROJECT_NAME, P2.END_DATE, P2.PM_USER_ID, P2.PL_USER_ID ORDER BY P2.PROJECT_ID
mapper.insert:
SELECT project_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO PROJECTS ( PROJECT_ID, PARENT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CREATED_BY, PM_USER_ID, PL_USER_ID, EDITOR_USER_ID, USE_MILESTONE ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, NULL, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 1, #{isPublic}, sysdate, NULL, #{createdBy}, #{pmUserId}, #{plUserId}, NULL, #{useMilestone} )
mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN GROUP_MEMBERS GM ON GM.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE GM.GROUP_ID = 6 AND U.is_active = 'O1' AND U.user_type = 'M2'

SELECT DISTINCT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME FROM PROJECT_MEMBERS PM JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = PM.USER_ID JOIN PROJECT_MEMBER_ROLES PMR ON PMR.PROJECT_MEMBER_ID = PM.PROJECT_MEMBER_ID JOIN ROLES R ON R.ROLE_ID = PMR.ROLE_ID WHERE PM.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND PM.IS_ACTIVE = 'O1' AND R.ROLE_NAME = 'PL' ORDER BY U.USER_ID
SELECT PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, START_DATE, END_DATE FROM PROJECTS WHERE PROJECT_ID=#{projectId}

SELECT RT.PROJECT_NAME AS ROOT_PROJECT_NAME, P.PROJECT_ID, P.PROJECT_NAME, P.SUB_PL_USER_ID, M.MILESTONE_ID, M.MILESTONE_NAME, U.USER_NAME FROM PROJECTS P JOIN PROJECTS RT ON RT.PROJECT_ID = P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN MILESTONE_MAPPING MM ON P.PROJECT_ID = MM.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN MILESTONES M ON MM.MILESTONE_ID = M.MILESTONE_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = P.SUB_PL_USER_ID WHERE P.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = #{parentProjectId} ORDER BY M.MILESTONE_ID NULLS LAST, P.PROJECT_ID
mapper.insert:
SELECT project_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO PROJECTS ( PROJECT_ID, IDENTIFIER, PARENT_PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, START_DATE, END_DATE, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, PM_USER_ID, PL_USER_ID, USE_MILESTONE, SUB_PL_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{identifier}, #{parentProjectId}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{isPublic}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, (SELECT PM_USER_ID FROM PROJECTS WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{parentProjectId}), (SELECT PL_USER_ID FROM PROJECTS WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{parentProjectId}), (SELECT USE_MILESTONE FROM PROJECTS WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{parentProjectId}), #{subPlUserId} )

SELECT milestone_mapping_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO MILESTONE_MAPPING ( MILESTONE_MAPPING_ID, MILESTONE_ID, PROJECT_ID, RELATION ) VALUES ( #{milestoneMappingId}, #{milestoneId}, #{projectId}, 'M1' )
